files.name: Medication Reconciliation Policy — Draft Rev 3.docx
files.summary: Draft revision 3 of the network medication-reconciliation policy, adopted in principle by the Quality Steering Committee on 10-JUN. Requires a documented reconciliation at every transition of care (admission, transfer, discharge). Pending workflow update (David Munoz) and compliance review (Priya Raman) before publication.
files.content_excerpt: Section 2 Scope: medication reconciliation shall be performed and documented at every transition of care across all network clinics. Section 5 Responsibility: clinic operations leads ensure workflow compliance; Quality audits adherence quarterly.

files.name: MediTech Biomedical — MSA & SLA Schedule.pdf
files.summary: Master Service Agreement and SLA schedule with MediTech Biomedical Inc. Covers biomedical equipment preventive maintenance, calibration, and emergency repair across all Northbridge clinics. SLA: 48-hour response for preventive maintenance, 4-hour response for critical equipment failure. Service credit: 10% of monthly fee per SLA breach. Auto-renewal 01-SEP annually with 60-day notice to terminate.
files.content_excerpt: Section 3 Scope: preventive maintenance and calibration for all biomedical equipment per FDA and Joint Commission standards. Section 7 SLA: 48h response for scheduled maintenance; 4h response for critical equipment (defibrillators, ventilators). Section 8 Service Credits: 10% of monthly fee per calendar month with an SLA breach.

files.name: PharmaLink — Distribution Agreement.pdf
files.summary: Distribution agreement with PharmaLink Distributors for clinical supplies and pharmacy distribution. Covers formulary kits, PPE, and controlled-substance audit materials. SLA: 5-business-day delivery for standard orders, 24-hour delivery for urgent orders. Service credit clause 5.2: 5% credit per week of delay on any line item. Renewal 15-OCT annually.
files.content_excerpt: Section 2 Scope: distribution of formulary kits, PPE supplies, and controlled-substance record-keeping materials. Section 5.2 Service Credits: 5% of delayed line-item value per week of delay beyond the committed delivery date. Section 9 Renewal: annual renewal on 15-OCT with 90-day rebid notice.

files.name: ClearPoint — Clinical Software License & Support Agreement.pdf
files.summary: License and support agreement with ClearPoint Clinical Solutions for CPOE, lab-order interface, and clinical decision support software. Covers the medication-interaction alerting module required for Joint Commission medication-management compliance. SLA: 99.5% uptime, 2-hour P1 incident response. Appendix C maps features to Joint Commission standards. Renewal 01-MAR-2027.
files.content_excerpt: Section 1 Scope: CPOE module, lab-order HL7 interface, and medication-interaction alerting (clinical decision support). Appendix C: feature-to-standard mapping for Joint Commission medication-management requirements. Section 6 SLA: 99.5% monthly uptime; 2h P1 response, 8h P2 response. Section 10 Renewal: 01-MAR-2027, 120-day notice.
